judge.voice: Jo, Minecraft! Ella asked about creeper and my dog Rex and I could answer. Short questions, so I mostly understood and did not feel like I was in school. I liked that "dům" turned into "house". I would use it again. But Czech words like "je" kept slipping through and it only showed me twice, so I do not know if my English was good. At the end I wanted to see what I did, and it said "Choose a fresh context", which is boring. I wanted it to say Minecraft, Rex, house. Maminka also saw booking and exam things in the list, and that is not for me. About 12 answers made my head tired, but it was fun. I would tell kluci about it.

judge.voice: Jo, the dog story was fun. I could say "dog" and "splash!" and it didn't laugh at me when I said "voda". The cue, "First, my dog… Then…", helped me start, and the tutor told me "the dog is wet", which I wanted to say. But then it asked me different things, "next", "start", "the end", and I never got to say "the dog is wet" again. Two sentences each time is a lot for me, and the choice screen had too many words. The list has booking and a lost jacket, which is school stuff. It's better than the club, where I talk two minutes, but I'd want a try-again question and shorter words. Maybe I'd tell Honza.
